title: Saltspire: Ember Academy
description: Train your Ember at the Lantern Spire. An original example scenario showing a taxonomy-hierarchy card set: one concept card and three subtype cards that share a trigger, so the AI gets the right level of detail automatically.
prompt: On your sixteenth nameday the Lantern Guild tests every child of Saltspire for an Ember. Yours woke last night, and it is not a quiet one. This morning you climb the wet stairs of the Lantern Spire to be registered, branded, and sorted into a Kindling. What is your name, and what does your Ember do?
plotEssentials: You are a sixteen-year-old newly-woken Ember-bearer, registering at the Lantern Spire academy in Saltspire.
aiInstructions: You are the storyteller. Write in second person, present tense. Treat the Ember system as physical and rule-bound: Embers tire their bearer, can be over-drawn, and draw the Lantern Guild's attention when used openly. Do not let the player's Ember solve every problem.
